albedoBack.source: BACK reference, mirrored into the FRONT UV frame, same de-light

roughness.source: silhouette distance field + measured serration/panel bands + seeded noise

metalness.source: worn-magwell-lip band only (Well-Worn polymer worn through)

ao.source: slide/frame seam + grip-panel recess + relief bands + silhouette falloff

normal.source: height field from the measured relief bands + grip stria + seeded micro noise

uvOrientation: planar XY in model space; u = (x - cropX0)/cropW, v = 1 - y/cropH
limitations: de-lighting is an approximation: the polished magwell specular streak and the slide's top gloss line stay baked into the albedo
no raw skin texture maps were available, so this is image-only, not exact-texture
